# heic-to 1.6.7 (vendored)

Unmodified copy of `dist/csp/heic-to.js` from the [heic-to](https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to) npm package, version 1.6.7 (libheif 1.23.7), licensed under LGPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE`).

It is loaded only when the browser can't decode a HEIC/HEIF photo itself (for example Chrome or Firefox). Decoding runs entirely in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

To update: `npm pack heic-to@<version>` and copy `package/dist/csp/heic-to.js` and `package/LICENSE` here.
